guidance.promptSnippet: Present structured choices when a user decision is needed
promptGuidelines: Use ask_user_question when concrete choices help resolve a material ambiguity or preference. Make routine implementation decisions yourself. Ask interview and coaching questions conversationally unless structured choices are requested.
Focus on one substantive decision at a time. If recommending an option, put it first and append (Recommended) to its label.

Follow the schema's question and option limits. Each option needs a short label and description. Custom input is built in; do not add Other or Type something. Use multiSelect only for independent choices and preview only when comparing concrete artifacts.
